note: *o vosso furor se afastou*, after two readers heard v1's *voltou atrás* as retracting; the v2 Latinist says it narrows *convérsus* and asks *se desviou* (*avértere*'s row verb).

*das fontes do Salvador*: the Latin's person, against the Lectionary refrain Brazilians sing, *manancial da salvação* (Hebrew). Also *Com júbilo*: the Latinist asked *alegria*; the open *gáudium* row decides.
*as suas invenções*, the open row (76:13 said of God); the stylist and the blind reader heard gadgets or fabrications. *obras* is *ópera*'s, *desígnios* *consílium*'s (D33).
*porque fez coisas magníficas*, the stylist's; the v2 Latinist notes the supplied object and asks *agiu magnificamente*, which brings back the heaviness.
